info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Guestpass-v3-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of available fitness memberships and their associated guest passes. It serves as a resource for potential customers looking to explore membership options and understand guest benefits. Typically used by gym management systems and fitness applications, this operation facilitates informed decision-making for users considering memberships. Developers can leverage this API to enhance user engagement by providing transparent access to membership details and guest policies.
